evidence.claim: Condition 11 is SATISFIED via the per-unit manifest allowed by STRUCTURAL-CONDITION-11.md. The global unit_manifest.py --check remains red on a sibling and is not this unit registration path.

probes.raw_output: per-unit manifest must name catalog output_path with live LF sha256

extensions.evidence_requirement: Emit a per-receipt row with path, exists, bytes, parse result and consumer-read result. The minimum size must be a declared constant with a rationale, and a mutation test must prove the default is actually exercised.
extensions.refute_basis: Prior harvest candidate false-passed digest drift, NaN JSON, and partial primary coverage. This verifier assigns those classes to conditions 2, 4, and 12.

negative_controls.description: Point the otherwise healthy receipt at a missing path; condition 2 must fail.
Replace the healthy artifact with zero bytes and then one byte; both fail the 64-byte floor.
Change DEFAULT_MIN_BYTES from 64 to 256 on the public path with no override.

residual_unknowns.claim: Schema-backed parse of program receipts is NOT-CHECKED on this tree because platform/lib/schema_resolver.py is not mounted.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Mount schema_resolver, re-run probe1_program_census.py, and require parse_result PASS or FAIL rather than NOT-CHECKED for every receipt that declares an output_schema.

pivot_alternatives: Restore and re-run probe1/probe2 with digest ownership, strict JSON, and full primary coverage.
Register via a per-unit manifest under STRUCTURAL-CONDITION-11 instead of the red global derive path.
retry.policy: two strikes then pivot; after the second identical failure enumerate at least two mechanically different alternatives before a third attempt

reviewer.notes: Planted missing-path, zero-byte, digest-drift, NaN, and partial-coverage receipts. All were caught. DEFAULT_MIN_BYTES source mutation killed the public path. Healthy fixture stayed green. Census ran over every live receipt. Global unit_manifest.py --write was not invoked.

sentinel: SUCCESS:CNF-0162 receipt-to-disk verifier evaluated conditions 2, 3, 4, and 12 over every live receipt; named probes re-ran to exit 0; per-unit UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json registers the catalog output_path
